rules.description: Parse HTML with stdlib HTMLParser; strip tags, attributes,

Selectively decode genuine encoded HTML markup before parsing without mistaking numeric comparisons (<1%, >200°C) for HTML tags; decode HTML entities; normalize Unicode to NFC; convert NBSP/figure/narrow spaces to ASCII spaces; remove zero-width/format chars (Cf) and C0/C1 control characters.

Convert keycap step emojis (1️⃣) to numbered markers (1.); remove decorative emojis, checkmarks (✅, 🔹, 📌, 🔧, 🚗, etc.), variation selectors, and Quill leading bullet dots while preserving technical symbols (°, ±, ≈, ≤, ≥, ×, ®, ™, №, %, /, -, :).

Remove non-technical CTA headings (e.g. 'Чому варто купити ...?', 'Як перевірити оригінальність...?'), authenticity/QR/URL/email/phone/shipping/payment/cart notices, and pure price/promotional fluff sentences while preserving all technical paragraphs, viscosity/ISO/NLGI grades, API/ACEA/OEM approvals, formally-approved vs meets-requirements distinctions, temperatures, ratios, and negations such as 'не містить'.
Deduplicate exact repeated blocks and sentences (case-insensitive, whitespace-normalized) within each individual product while preserving first occurrence and performing zero cross-product dedup.
